category: 國家童軍與女童軍總部 (National Scout & Guide HQ)
name: 聖馬力諾天主教童軍與女童軍協會總部
nameEn: Associazione Guide Esploratori Cattolici Sammarinesi Headquarters
address: Via Consiglio dei Dodici 10, Dogana, Republic of San Marino
description: AGECS 官方 Statuto 及 Privacy Policy 均列協會 sede 位於 Dogana (RSM), Via Consiglio dei Dodici n.10。WOSM 亦記錄 Associazione Guide e Esploratori Cattolici Sammarinesi / AGECS 為 San Marino 的 WOSM 成員 NSO。

category: 官方童軍物資倉 / Scout Shop (Members Depot)
name: AGECS Magazzino Scout
address: Via Consiglio dei Dodici 10, Dogana, Republic of San Marino
description: AGECS 官方 Magazzino Scout 頁列明 scout depot 位於 Dogana, Via Consiglio dei Dodici n.10，accesso riservato agli associati，用於 AGECS 成員 scout supplies / uniforms 等物資。

category: 全國童軍小組網絡 (National Scout Groups Network)
name: AGECS 三個 Scout Groups 網絡
address: Three scout groups across the Castelli of San Marino; contact via AGECS HQ
description: AGECS 官方「Lo scautismo a San Marino」頁說協會約 300 名成員，分成三個 Groups，分佈於 Città、Borgo Maggiore、Serravalle 三個 Castelli。WOSM 也說 San Marino 有三個 scout groups，所有三個年齡段均存在於三個 groups。

category: 地方童軍小組代表點 (Local Scout Group Representative Point)
name: Città di San Marino Scout Group 代表點
nameEn: AGECS Scout Group – Città di San Marino Representative Point
address: Città di San Marino, Republic of San Marino; contact via AGECS HQ
description: AGECS 官方頁列 Città 為三個 scout group 所在 Castelli 之一。本項為 Città di San Marino group 的代表點；具體聚會地點以 AGECS 回覆為準。

category: 地方童軍小組代表點 (Local Scout Group Representative Point)
name: Borgo Maggiore Scout Group 代表點
nameEn: AGECS Scout Group – Borgo Maggiore Representative Point
address: Borgo Maggiore, Republic of San Marino; contact via AGECS HQ
description: AGECS 官方頁列 Borgo Maggiore 為三個 scout group 所在 Castelli 之一，並說 San Marino 童軍在 1973 年於 Borgo Maggiore parish 持續恢復活動。本項為代表點。

category: 地方童軍小組代表點 (Local Scout Group Representative Point)
name: Serravalle / Dogana Scout Group 代表點
nameEn: AGECS Scout Group – Serravalle / Dogana Representative Point
address: Serravalle / Dogana, Republic of San Marino; contact via AGECS HQ
description: AGECS 官方頁列 Serravalle 為三個 scout group 所在 Castelli 之一；協會 sede / magazzino 亦位於 Serravalle 的 Dogana。此項作為 Serravalle/Dogana group 代表點。

name: Lupetti e Coccinelle（8–11 歲）
address: AGECS groups across San Marino; contact via AGECS HQ
description: AGECS Statuto Art.6 列 associati giovani 包括 Lupetti e Coccinelle（Branca L/C）；WOSM AGECS member article 說 San Marino scouting offers Lupetti/Coccinelle for ages 8 to 11 and all three sections are present in all three groups。

name: Esploratori e Guide（11–16 歲）
address: AGECS groups across San Marino; contact via AGECS HQ
description: AGECS Statuto Art.6 列 Esploratori e Guide（Branca E/G）；WOSM AGECS member article 說此 section 服務 11 至 16 歲青年。

name: Rover e Scolte（16–21 歲）
address: AGECS groups across San Marino; contact via AGECS HQ
description: AGECS Statuto Art.6 列 Rover e Scolte（Branca R/S）；WOSM AGECS member article 說 Rover/Scolta section 服務 16 至 21 歲青年。

category: 年度營隊計劃 / 營地聯絡點 (Camp Programme Contact Point)
name: AGECS campi invernali ed estivi 計劃
nameEn: AGECS Winter and Summer Camps Programme
address: Coordination via AGECS HQ and local groups, San Marino
description: 未見 AGECS 公布固定自有國家營地。Group information for San Marino 1-2 explains that campi invernali ed estivi are fundamental scout events; AGECS also regularly sends contingents to World Scout Jamborees. This entry records the official camps programme/contact point rather than a fixed campsite.

category: 服務與公民支援網絡 (Civil Protection / Service Network)
name: AGECS Protezione Civile 服務網絡
nameEn: AGECS Civil Protection and Community Service Network
address: Nationwide service activities; contact via AGECS HQ
description: AGECS Statuto Art.2 將 protezione civile 列為協會優先服務領域之一；AGECS 官方新聞記錄 2020 年疫情期間與 Protezione Civile di San Marino 合作，支援購物及藥物送遞等服務。
